o.text:
Etymology tree
Proto-Turkic *süŋük
Old Anatolian Turkish سكوك (süŋük)
Azerbaijani sümük
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish سكوك (süŋük), from Proto-Turkic *süŋük.
From Arabic تَشْكِيلَات (taškīlāt). By surface analysis, təşkil + -at

glosses: divine, godly (of or pertaining to God, Allah)

o.text: Borrowed from Arabic إِلٰهِي (ʔilāhī). By surface analysis, ilah + -i
From yay + -laq. Cognate with Turkish yaylak, Kazakh жайлау (jaylaw), etc.
Ultimately a derivation of Proto-Turkic *top (“all, completely”) + -la. Cognate with Turkish toplamak.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یویورمك (yüyürmek), یوكورمك (yügürmek) from Proto-Common Turkic *yügür- (“to run”). Cognate to Salar yükkürgüsi.
